raw:
Decision: INCLUDE or MAYBE? The paper designs and implements a text-based question-answering system that uses KG-RAG (LightRAG) to retrieve information before the LLM generates answers. That is a RAG method. The digital human and Unreal Engine parts are presentation layers rather than multimodal retrieval, so E9 does not apply. The abstract does not mention experiments, but the rules say not to exclude for missing baselines or metrics, and this is a system implementation that proposes a RAG-based architecture. I lean toward INCLUDE.
